decision_boundary: This contract freezes entry gates, weighted comparison rules, and candidates. It does not select, install, or replace a search engine.

entry_gates.name: OSI license and reproducible distribution
entry_gates.requirement: The exact candidate edition, version, and distribution license are OSI-approved and an immutable source or release with checksum evidence can be recorded.

entry_gates.name: BPM-controlled self-hosting
entry_gates.requirement: BPM can run the candidate without an account, paid hosted service, mandatory cloud control plane, or mandatory telemetry.

entry_gates.name: Six-locale route to parity
entry_gates.requirement: Primary evidence documents a credible indexing/tokenization route for en, ru, de, zh-CN, fr, and es-ES; M3-03 must still measure every locale.

entry_gates.name: Offline, CSP, and accessibility compatibility
entry_gates.requirement: The candidate has a design path that keeps documentation usable offline and permits BPM's same-origin CSP, keyboard, localized status, safe rendering, and degraded lexical behavior.

entry_gates.name: Facet and portal integration compatibility
entry_gates.requirement: The candidate can preserve BPM's guide/topic/channel/policy/CIS/API facets, URL state, result URLs, exact identifiers, reviewed aliases, and deterministic fallback through an adapter if necessary.

entry_gates.name: Maintainable operational boundary
entry_gates.requirement: The candidate has an active upstream or is repository-owned, has a bounded update/rollback path, and introduces no unowned public listener or network dependency.

gate_rule.visibility: All entry gates are explicit in this contract; there are no hidden vetoes.
gate_rule.admission: A candidate may enter an isolated M3-02 prototype only when every gate has recorded evidence or an explicit prototype condition that will be tested before comparison.
gate_rule.rejection: A candidate failing an entry gate is recorded with the failed gate and is not given a weighted score.

score_scale.meaning: 0 is no demonstrated fit; 5 is demonstrated fit on the frozen evidence.

dimensions.evidence: M3-03 six-locale corpus: Top-1, Recall@5, exact identifiers, aliases, typos, morphology, CJK, no-result behavior, and raw per-query results.
Per-locale evidence for en, ru, de, zh-CN, fr, and es-ES; no macro average may hide a failed locale.
M3-04 old-laptop raw samples: artifact bytes, startup, browser lexical-render P95, memory, and failure recovery.
M3-02/M3-04 prototype evidence for no-network operation, same-origin CSP, inert rendering, keyboard behavior, localized status, and degraded state.
M3-02/M3-03 evidence for existing facets, URL/filter state, result URLs, exact-ID priority, reviewed aliases, and browser-visible ranking parity.
Exact edition/version/license, immutable release/checksum, advisory check, update/rollback procedure, listener/process isolation, and upstream maintenance record.

weighted_matrix.scoring_rule: Use the same corpus revision and host protocol for every candidate. Record the score and evidence for every dimension; a missing measurement is unscored, never zero or an assumed pass.
weighted_matrix.selection_rule: M3-05 may select only after all admitted candidates have complete evidence. A candidate must score at least 4/5 for relevance and locale parity and meet all release floors; otherwise retain the current static control. Weighted total breaks ties only among candidates meeting those floors.

candidates.name: Current BPM deterministic static browser search

gate_evidence.SG093-E1: Repository-owned BPM source; no third-party search-engine distribution is introduced.
gate_evidence.SG093-E2: Current implementation is self-hosted and uses a same-origin local index.
gate_evidence.SG093-E3: Current per-locale index contract covers en, ru, de, zh-CN, fr, and es-ES.
gate_evidence.SG093-E4: Inventory records same-origin retrieval, CSP-safe DOM text rendering, and localized unavailable state.
gate_evidence.SG093-E5: Existing contracts define facets, URL state, result URLs, exact identifiers, and aliases.
gate_evidence.SG093-E6: BPM owns source, build, package, rollback, and no-listener behavior.

candidates.known_constraint: The browser scorer is simpler than the build-time scorer: it lacks bounded typo and alias-group semantics. Browser-visible results, not build-only fixtures, are the control measurement.

candidates.name: Pagefind

gate_evidence.SG093-E1: MIT license and immutable v1.5.2 release are published by the upstream project.
gate_evidence.SG093-E2: Upstream describes a fully static deployment with no hosted infrastructure requirement.
gate_evidence.SG093-E3: Upstream multilingual documentation covers per-language indexing and explicit stemming/segmentation paths for the six BPM locales.
gate_evidence.SG093-E4: Static deployment is a credible path; the BPM adapter must prove offline, CSP, accessibility, and failure behavior.
gate_evidence.SG093-E5: Upstream filter API is a credible path; the prototype must prove every BPM facet, URL-state, ranking, alias, and result-URL invariant.
gate_evidence.SG093-E6: The project publishes versioned releases; BPM still must record checksum, advisory, upgrade, and rollback evidence before selection.

prototype_conditions: No Pagefind default UI is adopted without BPM's localized accessible adapter.
No candidate result is accepted until browser-visible ranking parity and every BPM facet/filter contract are measured.
No network request other than same-origin local documentation assets is permitted in local mode.

candidates.name: Meilisearch Community Edition

gate_evidence.SG093-E1: Only the MIT-licensed Community Edition v1.45.1 is in scope; Enterprise terms are excluded.
gate_evidence.SG093-E2: A self-hosted daemon is possible, but only behind a BPM-owned same-origin adapter without account, cloud, or telemetry requirement.
gate_evidence.SG093-E3: Upstream documents language configuration and tokenization routes for Latin languages, German compounds, Cyrillic/Russian, and Chinese segmentation; BPM must configure and measure all six locales.
gate_evidence.SG093-E4: The adapter must prove that the browser never contacts the daemon and that disabled/offline/degraded lexical search remains usable.
gate_evidence.SG093-E5: Its filtering and typo controls are candidates for an adapter; exact BPM facet/filter, URL, ranking, and alias parity remain prototype requirements.
gate_evidence.SG093-E6: The release is versioned, but selection requires an advisory review, checksum, lifecycle, private binding, and clean-stop/rollback evidence.

prototype_conditions: Use only the Community Edition artifact and license; do not mix Enterprise features or terms.
Bind the daemon to a BPM-owned private boundary; expose no LAN/public listener and ensure the browser never contacts the daemon directly.
A failed, stopped, or incompatible daemon must not delay or disable the independent static lexical fallback.

additional_candidate_policy: No additional candidate is admitted in M3-01. An added candidate must document primary evidence for all six entry gates and use the same M3-02 through M3-04 evidence path; popularity, a benchmark from another product, or a build-time-only result is insufficient.
